📖 Reading Text

Climate change is one of the most pressing issues of our time. Rising global temperatures have led to melting polar ice caps, more frequent extreme weather events, and shifting ecosystems. Scientists agree that human activity, particularly the burning of fossil fuels, is the primary driver of these changes.

Feedback & Answers
Key takeaway: Human activity drives climate change.

Feedback & Answers
1. Alexander welcomes everyone. 2. Photovoltaic solar efficiency has doubled. 3. Offshore wind energy in the UK. 4. Mini solar water heaters. 5. Whole communities get inspired to go green.
🗂️ Multiple Choice Quiz Easy · 5 XP
  • Choose the correct answer:
  • 1. What does 'sustainable' mean?
  • a) Able to continue over time b) Quick and efficient c) Expensive
  • 2. Which is a renewable energy source?
  • a) Coal b) Solar c) Oil
🔊 Shadowing — Repeat After Me

Listen and repeat: 'Climate change is affecting every continent on Earth. The polar ice caps are melting at an alarming rate. We must take action now to reduce our carbon footprint.'

Feedback & Answers
Focus on intonation and rhythm!
✅ True/False — Reading Check Easy · 5 XP
  • True or False?
  • 1. Climate change is caused only by natural factors. (False)
  • 2. Renewable energy comes from sources that can be depleted. (False)
  • 3. The burning of fossil fuels contributes to global warming. (True)
🎯 Word Stress — Which syllable? Easy · 5 XP
  • Identify the stressed syllable:
  • 1. EC-o-sys-tem (1st) vs e-co-SYS-tem (Wrong)
  • 2. EN-vi-ron-ment (1st) vs en-VI-ron-ment (2nd) vs en-vi-RON-ment (3rd)
🎯 Sentence Stress — Key Words Easy · 5 XP
  • Which words carry the main stress?
  • Read: 'Global WARMing is a GLOB-al CRIS-is.'
  • The stressed words carry the meaning.
